fields.title: test: vitest under Bun cannot stub HOME env (vi.stubEnv ignored by os.homedir)
fields.description:
Bun 1.3.14 caches os.homedir() at process start; setting process.env.HOME later does not change the value. vitest's vi.stubEnv('HOME', tempHome) therefore has no effect on tau code that uses os.homedir() (extensions/tau/src/shared/discovery.ts:getUserAgentsDir, similar resolvers).

Reproduction:
  HOME=/tmp/x bun -e 'import("os").then(o=>console.log(o.homedir()))'
  -> /tmp/x  (works, set via env at launch)

  bun -e 'process.env.HOME="/tmp/x"; import("os").then(o=>console.log(o.homedir()))'
  -> /home/oknyshuk  (broken; cached)

Affected tests (~25 fail under Bun even on main with no migration):
- test/agent-registry-strict-config.test.ts (16)
- test/agent-startup-validation.test.ts (3)
- test/agent-registry-bundled-agents.test.ts (2)
- test/agents-menu.test.ts (2)
- test/app-runtime.test.ts (1)
- test/shell-service.test.ts (1)

Fix options:
1. Replace os.homedir() with a tau-internal helper that reads process.env.HOME (or a contextual home path) so vi.stubEnv works.
2. Inject the home path / agentDir as an explicit dependency through AgentRegistry.load and similar entry points (preferred per Final Form: invalid states unrepresentable).
3. Use an absolute env var like TAU_HOME that overrides os.homedir() in tests.

Pre-existing under tau-zwnlvppr ('fix: make tau load under bun'), exposed by tau-1qfx migration which made more test files import successfully.

Acceptance:
- All ~25 pre-existing Bun-related test failures pass
- npm run gate is green from extensions/tau under both bun and node
- Add a regression test that confirms vi.stubEnv('HOME', ...) is honored across the agent registry and discovery modules.
